title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user that holds a role with the System Settings view permission…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain an authorization vulnerability where authenticated users with the System Settings view permission but without the Assets view permission can access asset and tenant metadata via the ingestion history view. This occurs because the ingestion history view does not properly restrict summary results to only those assets and tenants the user is authorized to view.
